name: providers_list
description: providers with {"action": "list"} must enumerate the configured providers as ok:true without any network traffic or token spend — list is the deliberately free sibling of check. The assertion is only the ok field, so the case is indifferent to which providers a given machine has configured; it goes red when the config read (fs_prefixes on config.json/config.local.json) or the list serialization breaks, failures that check-with-network would otherwise mask behind provider flakiness.
prompt: Use the providers tool with input {"action": "list"}. Do not use the check action. Look at the tool's JSON result and reply with only the value of its "ok" field: true or false.
